name: Atlantosuchus
sum: Atlantosuchus is a dyrosaurid crocodylomorph from the Paleocene of Morocco with the proportionally longest snout of any dyrosaurid.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from Couche II and an unnamed unit in Morocco.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Buffetaut and Wouters 1979
